response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), stats AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, COUNT(*) as num_observatories FROM telescope_counts) SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_telescopes as share, CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_telescopes - 1.0 / s.num_observatories as difference_from_avg FROM telescope_counts tc CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_telescopes > 1.0 / s.num_observatories ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
